Name: Obed-edom, Porter
Summary: Levite porter appointed at the bringing up of the ark, and later porter before the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:18; 1 Chronicles 15:21; 1 Chronicles 16:38: Levite porter appointed at the bringing up of the ark, and later porter before the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Obed-edom in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
